Receiving a Stage IV leukemia diagnosis is incredibly overwhelming, and it is completely understandable that reading about palliative care left you feeling depressed. It is worth noting that palliative care is often misunderstood; it focuses on managing symptoms and improving your quality of life alongside active treatments, rather than meaning you have to give up. Still, your instinct to rest and gather your strength right now is incredibly wise. Taking a moment to breathe can give you the physical and emotional energy you need.

Your determination to seek second opinions and explore clinical trials shows immense inner strength. Advocating for yourself is one of the most powerful things you can do. To muster your courage, try focusing on just one step at a time—start by simply resting, then reach out to major research centers when you feel ready. The very fact that you are looking for ways to forge ahead shows that you already possess the courage and determination you are seeking.
